issues.title: UI issues on collaborative working
issues.body:
I identified two issues on the new collaborative working UI.

I'm moving them out of the collab-working PR, so I can merge it, and release playable reviews from `develop`.

* New message control scrolls up page, [here](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/pull/1026#issuecomment-908258243)
* Assign-to menu shown behind json editor, [here](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/pull/1026#issuecomment-908409445)
* Could you pleas make the current message collapse when any `action button` are performed.  For example, when we `Submit` a message, we no longer need to see it.
